import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a histogram for the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(x='amount', data=credit_fraud, kde=True, color='skyblue')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_amount_dist.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, order=credit_fraud['transaction_type'].value_counts().index)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_transaction_types.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of hours of the day
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=credit_fraud, order=credit_fraud['hour_of_day'].value_counts().index)
plt.title('Distribution of Hours of the Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_hours_of_day.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a scatter plot for the relationship between transaction amounts and hours of the day (fraudulent transactions highlighted)
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=credit_fraud, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Relationship between Transaction Amounts and Hours of the Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')
plt.savefig('output_amount_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
